questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.answer: Not easy in Munich. The housing can be very hard as there is lot off competion

questions.answer: Be early and don't expect dorms to be available. The likelihood of that is less than 25 %

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Quite annoyed in the beginning but found good roommates far out

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: It is Germany to much paper work. Germany is still in another century

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: As I remember pay a fee get a login for LMU and another platform called LSF login find a website that is made in 2004. Call the for help and student assist did it for me

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: You could call or use an email or in person but did not do it as it was inconvenient

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I wanted other classes they were not this semester as they change every year. Can be hard to get specific classes

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Have only electives else you can run into issues

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: It was fun good vibes and good academic level

questions.answer: I did only do ESN else i just went with people I met an did stuff

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Go hiking in the Alps it is so beautiful

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: The Alps, Salzbrug, Prag, Christmas Market, Oktoberfest, Berlin, Rothenburg, Ulm, Venice you are in the middle of Europe there are so many opportunities

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: I half german so Germany is not very different to me

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Yes, speak german or just be social. Ask for help in class

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: They have more respect for Authorities but I knew that

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The beauty of Munich and the biergarten's

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Beer, Brezel and Bayern or maybe go if you like that

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Always have Cash on you. Cash is key in Germany

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Getting new friends from all over Europe

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Actually studying. Can be hard when you have all these fun things to do with a lot of fun new people

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: Come to Munich for the Life experience of both the academic and social life

questions.answer: Yes
